title: Flood Warning
description: ...The National Weather Service in Seattle has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in Washington... Skokomish River At Potlatch affecting Mason County. .Heavy rain over the Olypics overnight plus an additional 2-4 inches of rain, with snow levels well above mountain tops will drive the Skokomish River above flood stage this afternoon to above Moderate flood. * WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast. This approaches the flood of record. * WHERE...Skokomish River at Potlatch. * WHEN...From this afternoon to Friday evening. * IMPACTS...At 17.5 feet, the Skokomish River will cause moderate flooding, with deep and quick flood waters inundating some residential areas, many roads, and much of the farm land in the Skokomish Valley. title: Flood Warning
description: ...The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in North Carolina... Neuse River Near Clayton affecting Johnston County. * WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Neuse River near Clayton. * WHEN...From this afternoon to Friday afternoon. * IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, Upstream of the gage site, the Neuse River Greenway at Covered Bridge Road begins to flood. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 9:15 AM EST Thursday the stage was 7.7 feet. - Bankfull stage is 8.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late this afternoon to a crest of 9.6 feet this evening. It will then fall below flood stage just after midnight tonight. - Flood stage is 9.0 feet. - Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 9.3 feet on 10/12/2018. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

title: Flood Warning
description: ...The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a Flood Warning for the following rivers in North Carolina... Northeast Cape Fear River Near Burgaw affecting Pender County. * WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Northeast Cape Fear River near Burgaw. * WHEN...From Friday morning to late Monday night. * IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Flooding worsens in the River Bend, River Birch and Alligator Lake subdivisions. Flooding on Croomsbridge RD and Old Maple Hill RD worsens and the roads may be impassable in multiple locations. Holly Shelter Estates begins to flood and flooding in Sandy Bend worsens. Flooding worsens near the ends of Turtle Hill TR, Hickory Hill LN, White Tail LN, Mallard Roost DR, and Oxbow Landing. Shaw Hwy is flooded at Ashes and Lillington Creeks. Equine Landing RD area may flood. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 8:30 AM EST Thursday the stage was 4.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late tomorrow morning to a crest of 11.6 feet early Saturday afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage late Monday morning. - Flood stage is 10.0 feet. - weather.gov/safety/flood

title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... St Johns River Near Deland affecting Lake and Volusia Counties. .Previous rainfall working through the basin will cause river levels on the St. Johns at Deland to continue rising through Major Flood Stage. The river is forecast to rise above its former record crest this weekend, reaching 6.4 feet, where it is expected to linger into early next week. For the St. Johns River...including Deland...Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast. This approaches the flood of record. * WHERE...St Johns River near Deland. * WHEN...Until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 5.3 feet, Major flooding occurs to many structures and marinas along the river and in the Hontoon Island area. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 8:30 AM EST Thursday the stage was 6.0 feet. - Bankfull stage is 3.5 feet. - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 8:30 AM EST Thursday was 6.0 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to rise through Major Flood Stage, reaching 6.4 feet late this weekend. The river is then forecast to remain steady through early next week. - Flood stage is 4.0 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

title: Flood Warning
description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... St Johns River Near Above Lake Harney affecting Seminole County. .Rainfall working through the basin has caused river levels on the St. Johns Above Lake Harney near Geneva to remain within Major Flood Stage, above its previous record flood stage. River levels are forecast to hold near a crest of 13.2 feet through late week, before beginning a very slow decline within Major flood stage this weekend and early next week. For the St. Johns River...including Lake Harney...Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast. This approaches the flood of record. * WHERE...St Johns River near Above Lake Harney. * WHEN...Until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 10.8 feet, Water covers State Road 46 and it may become impassable near Jungle Road and Prevatt Road. Standing water on secondary roads near the river deepens to more than three feet in some areas. Flooding becomes more significant to structures and marinas from above Lake Harney to the Lake Jesup area. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 7:30 AM EST Thursday the stage was 13.2 feet. - Bankfull stage is 6.0 feet. - Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending at 7:30 AM EST Thursday was 13.2 feet. - Forecast...The river is expected to remain within Major Flood Stage, steady at 13.2 feet through late week. A slow decline may begin over the weekend. - Flood stage is 8.0 feet. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
